guide.summary: Partner app on Harvest v3 for customers (partner acceptance); Custom AI client on Greenhouse MCP server (approval path unconfirmed). Where the path is unconfirmed, the agent did not find it in the provider's docs.
guide.verdict: Partner app on Harvest v3 for customers (partner acceptance).

composio.note: Composio lists Greenhouse as managed OAuth. Composio docs do not say which Greenhouse method is managed, so check the toolkit page.

need_own_app.answer: Not for prototypes: Composio's managed app works. For production under your own brand, you need your own partner-issued credentials, which require Greenhouse partner acceptance and a signed agreement first.
reasons: Consent screen shows your brand instead of 'Composio wants to access your account'
Dedicated rate-limit quota instead of one shared across all Composio users
Shorter polling intervals than the 15-minute managed minimum

prerequisites.title: At least one mutual customer
prerequisites.detail: Greenhouse requires one mutual customer before an integration request can be submitted.

prerequisites.title: Active website with a Privacy Policy
prerequisites.detail: Required to apply to the Integration Partner Program.

prerequisites.title: 128x128 logo file

steps.title: Use Composio managed auth for prototyping
steps.detail: Create the Greenhouse connection with Composio's managed OAuth app. Check the toolkit page for which method is managed.
steps.done_when: A test account is connected through Composio.

steps.title: Submit the integration request form
steps.detail: Describe your integration and goals. You need a mutual customer and a website with a Privacy Policy.

steps.title: Wait for monthly review and outreach
steps.detail: Requests are reviewed on the first Monday of the month, and Greenhouse reaches out within 7 business days. Do not proceed until officially confirmed.
steps.done_when: You are invited to sign the Partnership Agreement.

steps.title: Sign the Greenhouse Partnership Agreement
steps.detail: Legal sign-off on your side is required before you can create an OAuth app.

steps.title: Draft credential request to Partner Support
steps.detail: Prepare integration name, environment, required scopes, redirect URI(s), and logo. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

steps.title: Send request and receive credentials
steps.detail: Email Greenhouse Partner Support. Greenhouse issues the Client ID and Client Secret; keep the secret confidential.
steps.done_when: You have the Client ID and Secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config through Composio's API with your own client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection works.

steps.title: Request production and Directory review
steps.detail: Tell Greenhouse the final redirect URI once tested, and choose production rather than sandbox. Submit for Partner Directory review.
steps.done_when: Integration is live for mutual customers.

steps.title: Implement PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration
steps.detail: Build the OAuth flow with a separate token per user and register a distinct client_id.
steps.done_when: Client registers and receives a client_id.

steps.title: Ask Greenhouse to allowlist redirect URI
steps.detail: Contact Greenhouse or your account team; this is a manual step today.

traps.detail: After scopes are added, the end user (not an admin) must re-authorize the connection, going through the Initiate Connection flow again, before the new scopes apply.

traps.title: Authorization codes last 1 minute and must be exchanged
traps.detail: Authorization codes last 1 minute and must be exchanged quickly.

traps.title: Refresh tokens last 14 days; if unused for 14
traps.detail: Refresh tokens last 14 days; if unused for 14 days, the user must repeat the whole authorization flow.

traps.title: No self-serve registration
traps.detail: Greenhouse issues the client ID and secret itself after partner acceptance. Submitting the form does not guarantee acceptance.

traps.title: Review runs only monthly
traps.detail: Missing the monthly review can add weeks. Out-of-cycle review is generally granted only for an urgent mutual-customer request.

traps.title: Refresh tokens expire after 14 days unused

traps.detail: You cannot change scopes yourself, and users must re-authorize afterwards.

traps.title: Redirect URI must match exactly

traps.detail: Users see 'Composio wants to access your account', and quota is shared across Composio users.

traps.title: Site Admin changing scopes invalidates MCP tokens
traps.detail: All active MCP tokens in the organization are invalidated and users must re-authorize.

blockers.symptom: Application not accepted or no response
blockers.what_it_means: Not all submissions are accepted, and you must wait for official confirmation.
blockers.what_to_do: Wait for the monthly review. Email partneronboarding@greenhouse.io only if a mutual customer has an urgent need.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the application and out-of-cycle request.

blockers.symptom: invalid_scope error or HTTP 401 on code exchange
blockers.what_it_means: The scopes requested are not permitted for your client.
blockers.what_to_do: Contact Partner Support to adjust scopes.
blockers.agent_can_help: Compare requested scopes with those registered.

blockers.what_it_means: The authorizing user lacks the needed in-app Greenhouse permissions.
blockers.what_to_do: Have a user with the right permissions authorize, or a Site Admin use a service account.
